name: PA-717 Planetary Assault Goliath
description: PA-717 Planetary Assault Goliath was a massive-sized Skytrooper, a battle droid used by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul. During the Invasion of Voss in 3630 BBY, it was deployed in the middle of Voss-Ka, where it was destroyed by Lana Beniko and the Alliance Commander.
